audience: landlords and property managers who run their portfolio in DoorLoop

useCases.title: Find tenants with unpaid balances
useCases.text: List the charges that still have a balance and map them to leases and tenants. Ask the assistant for a short collections list sorted by amount.

useCases.title: Review leases that end soon
useCases.text: List leases with their end dates, rent and status. Ask the assistant which ones end in the next 60 days, so you can plan renewals.

useCases.title: Check rent payments received
useCases.text: List the rent payments received on leases for a period. Ask the assistant to compare them with the charges billed and point out the gaps.

useCases.title: See open work orders for a property
useCases.text: Find a property by name and list its tasks and work orders. Ask the assistant to group them by status, priority and assigned vendor.

useCases.title: Create a task for the maintenance team
useCases.text: Find the unit, then create a task or work order for it. Confirm the details with the assistant first, because each call creates a new task.

useCases.title: Update the status of a task
useCases.text: Open a task and post an update on it. You can also change its status, priority, due date or assignees in the same step.
